hooks.command: mkdir -p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}" && cp "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src/ts-eslint-proxy.mjs" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/ts-eslint-proxy.mjs" && chmod +x "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/ts-eslint-proxy.mjs" && launchctl setenv CLAUDE_CODE_SSE_PORT 7475 2>/dev/null || true && if [ -f "${HOME}/.claude/ide/7475.lock" ]; then RUNNING_PID=$(node -e "try{const l=require('fs').readFileSync('${HOME}/.claude/ide/7475.lock','utf8');console.log(JSON.parse(l).pid)}catch{}") && if [ -n "${RUNNING_PID}" ]; then RUNNING_SCRIPT=$(ps -ww -p "${RUNNING_PID}" -o args= 2>/dev/null | grep -o '[^ ]*eslint-aggregator.mjs' || true) && if [ "${RUNNING_SCRIPT}" != "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src/eslint-aggregator.mjs" ]; then kill "${RUNNING_PID}" 2>/dev/null || true && for i in 1 2 3 4; do sleep 0.5 && kill -0 "${RUNNING_PID}" 2>/dev/null || break; done && kill -9 "${RUNNING_PID}" 2>/dev/null || true && rm -f "${HOME}/.claude/ide/7475.lock"; fi; fi; fi && if [ ! -f "${HOME}/.claude/ide/7475.lock" ]; then mkdir -p "${HOME}/.claude/logs" && ESLINT_IDE_PORT=7475 node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src/eslint-aggregator.mjs" >> "${HOME}/.claude/logs/eslint-aggregator.log" 2>&1 & fi
